comments.plain_body: Intern note: kunden er CFO hos Contoso, se sag hos Lars Nielsen.

reasons.Mette: the 'mette_soerensen' tag leak (lower-case, ASCII-transliterated given name) IS closed by GLiNER (config/gliner.json threshold 0.65, 'person name' label scores ~0.74-0.89 on the bare tag) — but 'Mette' still leaks via the 'faktura_MetteSørensen.pdf' attachment filename, see the 'Sørensen' note; moved out of expectedPass2.absent because that source alone still leaks it
reasons.Sørensen: leaks via the 'faktura_MetteSørensen.pdf' attachment filename (name embedded with no surrounding spaces). GLiNER can be made to flag the whole filename as an entity (a 'file name containing a person name'-style label scores ~0.32-0.45 on it, comfortably below scores for plain false positives like the 'partner'/'gold_tier' tags at the same threshold), but the span it returns covers the ENTIRE filename, not just the embedded name — redacting it would also remove 'faktura' from output, which tests/fixtures/tickets/attachments.json's expected.present requires stay visible. No threshold/label change closes this leak without that regression, so it is a genuine Plan-2 recall gap, not tuned away; moved out of expectedPass2.absent, kept here as a recorded gap (see attachments.json for the same finding)
